card.name: Cockcroft-Gault formula digit after 14
card.fires_on: The digit 0 completing "14 " in the Cockcroft-Gault creatinine clearance formula, just before "- age". Weaker hits occur inside "Glomerular Filtration" and on "mL" in kidney-function cutoffs.
